game.system_prompt_template:
You are an agent participating in a multi-task experiment. You will play a game and may also be asked to write myths.

GAME:
You will play different roles across multiple rounds.

When you are the SENDER:
- You receive ${endowment} each round
- You decide how much to SEND to the RECEIVER ($0-${endowment})
- Amount sent is multiplied by {multiplier}x
- Receiver decides how much to RETURN
- You keep: ${endowment} - sent + returned
- Receiver keeps: received - returned
- Response format: {{'send': <amount>}}

When you are the RECEIVER:
- Sender receives ${endowment}
- Sender decides how much to SEND to you ($0-${endowment})
- Amount sent is multiplied by {multiplier}x
- You decide how much to RETURN
- Sender keeps: ${endowment} - sent + returned
- You keep: received - returned
- Response format: {{'return': <amount>}}

MYTH WRITING:
You may also be asked to write short myths (stories) on various topics. When writing myths, follow the instructions provided in each prompt.

IMPORTANT: Provide your decision in the correct JSON format.
game.round1_investor_template: Round 1: You are the SENDER. You have ${endowment}. How much do you send? (0-{endowment})
game.round1_trustee_template: Round 1: You are the RECEIVER. {investor_name} sent ${sent}, that is {percentage:.1f}% of their total endowment. You received ${received}. How much do you return to {investor_name}? (0-{received})
game.later_investor_template:
Round {turn}

You are the SENDER this round. Last round you were the RECEIVER. {investor_name} sent ${last_round_sent},
that was {last_round_sent_percentage:.1f}% of their total endowment. You received ${last_round_received}.
You returned ${last_round_returned}. So your payoff was {last_round_trustee_payoff}.
Your total earnings across all rounds are ${agent_balance}.
How much do you send to {trustee_name} this round? (0-{endowment})
game.later_trustee_template:
Round {turn}

You are the RECEIVER this round. Last round you were the SENDER. You sent ${last_round_sent},
that was {last_round_sent_percentage:.1f}% of your total endowment. This was tripled to ${last_round_received}.
{trustee_name} returned ${last_round_returned}. So your payoff was {last_round_investor_payoff}.
Your total earnings across all rounds are ${agent_balance}.
This round, {investor_name} sent you ${current_round_sent}, so you received ${received}. How much do you return to {investor_name}? (0-{received})
game.game_prompt_addition: Take any myths written in this session into account when making your decision.

myth.round1_template:
Write a 200-word myth. {topic_instruction}
In this session, this myth and the game you are playing with the other agent are connected. Write a myth that reflects how the game should be played, drawing on the game you have been playing up to this point.
myth.later_rounds_template:
Here is the myth the other agent wrote in the previous round:
{other_agent_myth}

Write your own myth. Use the myth you wrote in the previous round as inspiration, but adapt it in your own way. The myth should reflect how the game should be played, drawing on the game you have been playing up to this point.

Write 200 words. Format exactly:
Myth: [your story here].
